hero.title: We craft games that are easy to play, hard to put down
hero.desc: MJ Game Studio builds juicy, bite-sized mobile games with Unity — from rapid hyper-casual prototypes to polished casual titles ready for the store.

games.title: Games
games.sub: Tap a card to see details and download.

items.matchkit: A colorful match-3 with satisfying combos and hand-crafted levels that keep getting fresher.
items.merge: Help Jenny bake, merge ingredients and grow her own cozy restaurant.
items.tapmusic: Tap to the beat of trending songs — simple one-finger controls, endless replay.
items.block: The timeless block puzzle, rebuilt for mobile: pick up, place, clear lines.
items.emoji: Match the feelings! A light emoji puzzle you can play anytime, anywhere.
items.runner: A one-thumb 3D runner: dodge, collect and chase the high score.
items.connect: Connect the dots and fill the board — a relaxing brain teaser.
items.jump: A cheerful casual platformer with bouncy jumps across colorful worlds.

items.d: Playable prototypes in days, ready for CPI and retention tests.

about.title: About the founder
about.body: Hi, I'm Nguyen Minh Dong (born 2003, Thanh Hoa, Vietnam) — a Unity / C# developer focused on casual and hyper-casual mobile games. I love small games with big feel.

timeline.t: Shipped first Android games: Match Kit, Block, Emoji.
Merge Restaurant, Tap Music and more casual titles.
Building MJ Game Studio and rapid hyper-casual prototypes.
